name: Decluttering Method
description: Guides users through systematic decluttering using category-based or room-based methods. Provides decision frameworks for what to keep, donate, or discard, with specific criteria for common item types. Includes time estimates per category and strategies for maintaining a decluttered space. Use when the user asks about decluttering, reducing possessions, organizing before a move, or creating more space in their home. Do NOT use for regular cleaning routines (use weekly-cleaning-schedule), professional organizing services for hoarding situations, or room layout and furniture arrangement (use room-organization-system).
